title: The causes of Nephite loss
summary: Mormon attributes the Nephites’ great loss and slaughter to wickedness and abomination, including among those who professed to belong to the church of God. He lists pride, riches, oppression, and other conduct as causes.

explicit_facts.text: The Nephites suffered great loss and slaughter, which Mormon says would not have happened without their wickedness and abomination.
Wickedness and abomination were also among those who professed to belong to the church of God.

Mormon lists pride, exceeding riches, oppression of the poor, withholding food and clothing, smiting humble brethren, mocking sacred things, denying prophecy and revelation, murder, plunder, lying, stealing, adultery, contention, and desertion into the land of Nephi among the Lamanites.

title: Fear and remembrance

They saw that they had altered and trampled the laws of Mosiah, and that their laws had become corrupted and they had become wicked like the Lamanites.
